newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ building consents rise 8.0 pct in Aug year.
newsitem.headline: NZ building consents rise 8.0 pct in Aug year.

text.p: The total value of building consents for the August year was $5.896 billion, up 8.0 percent on the August 1995 year, Statistics New Zealand said on Friday.
"Consents for non-residential buildings show no sign of falling from the high level maintained since late 1994," it said.
Consents valued at $2.32 billion were authorised for non-residential buildings in the August year, up 11 percent on the August 1995 year. Consents in August were $205.9 million.
Consents for residential buildings in August were valued at $297.2 million with a total of 1791 dwelling consents issued.
The national median consent value for new dwellings was $120,000, the same as in August 1995.
